dialogues.jp: 「あ〜……かったる」
dialogues.en: "Huh...... what a pain."
dialogues.text: "Huh...... what a pain."

dialogues.jp:
洗い物や洗濯物もそのままに、帰宅するなりソ
ファーでだれる。
dialogues.en:
I sunk into the couch as soon as I got back home from the
school, leaving the pile of dishes and laundry aside.
dialogues.text:
I sunk into the couch as soon as I got back home from the
school, leaving the pile of dishes and laundry aside.

dialogues.jp:
食器洗い乾燥機でもあれば、するかもしれない。
洗濯も洗剤入れてスタートボタンを押すだけな
らするんだけどな……。
dialogues.en:
I wish we had a dishwasher. Also, I wish doing laundry was
as simple as pushing a single button......
dialogues.text:
I wish we had a dishwasher. Also, I wish doing laundry was
as simple as pushing a single button......

dialogues.jp: 一つ一つしわを伸ばして干すのは面倒だ。
dialogues.en: I hate hanging all of my clothes neatly to dry.
dialogues.text: I hate hanging all of my clothes neatly to dry.

dialogues.jp: 「うぐぅぅ……」

こうなると、炊事はともかく、ずっと文句も言
わず家事をしていた音夢のありがたみを痛感せ
ずにはいられない。
dialogues.en:
Now that I'm alone, I can finally appreciate how Nemu was
taking care of all the chores without complaining. Well,
except for her cooking......
dialogues.text:
Now that I'm alone, I can finally appreciate how Nemu was
taking care of all the chores without complaining. Well,
except for her cooking......

dialogues.jp:
電話でもかかってきたら、感謝の言葉を贈って
おこう……。
dialogues.en: I should thank her when she calls me the next time......
dialogues.text: I should thank her when she calls me the next time......

dialogues.jp: ――ピンポーン
dialogues.en: ...Ding dong.
dialogues.text: ...Ding dong.

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 誰だよ、余計な仕事を増やすヤツは。
dialogues.en: Who's here to cause me trouble?
dialogues.text: Who's here to cause me trouble?

dialogues.jp:
かったるいが、家に俺ひとりきりでは無視する
ことは出来ない。
dialogues.en:
I don't feel like answering the door, but being the only
person at home, I can't just ignore it.
dialogues.text:
I don't feel like answering the door, but being the only
person at home, I can't just ignore it.

dialogues.jp: ソファーから立ち上がり、インターホンにでる。
dialogues.en:
I pulled up my heavy body from the couch and answered the
intercom.
dialogues.text:
I pulled up my heavy body from the couch and answered the
intercom.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 『あの、こんにちは朝倉くん』
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: 耳に馴染んだ声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: I heard the familiar voice in my ears.
dialogues.text: I heard the familiar voice in my ears.

dialogues.jp: 「え！？　ちょっと待っててください！」
dialogues.en: "What? I'll be there right away!"
dialogues.text: "What? I'll be there right away!"

dialogues.jp:
受話器を落としそうになりながら元に戻すと、
ドタドタと廊下を鳴らして玄関に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I almost dropped the phone as I hung up, and ran toward the
front door.
dialogues.text:
I almost dropped the phone as I hung up, and ran toward the
front door.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは。どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Hi. What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Hi. What are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんのお家を、お掃除しにきました」
dialogues.en: "I came to clean your house."
dialogues.text: "I came to clean your house."

dialogues.jp: ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩に｛めまい／眩暈｝を覚える。
dialogues.en: I felt dizzy as I looked her smile.
dialogues.text: I felt dizzy as I looked her smile.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしてそんな？」
dialogues.en: "But why?"
dialogues.text: "But why?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「お掃除は毎日しないといけませんし。それに
　私は朝倉くんの彼女ですから……」
dialogues.en:
"Houses need to be cleaned every day. Moreover, I'm your
girlfriend......"
dialogues.text:
"Houses need to be cleaned every day. Moreover, I'm your
girlfriend......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いいですよね……」
dialogues.en: "Is that okay......?"
dialogues.text: "Is that okay......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「も、もちろん！」
dialogues.en: "Sure!"
dialogues.text: "Sure!"

dialogues.jp: 彼女か――いい響きだ。
dialogues.en: Girlfriend, huh......? That sounds good.
dialogues.text: Girlfriend, huh......? That sounds good.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「おじゃまします」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me."

dialogues.jp: 俺のあとに続いて萌先輩が居間に入ってくる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai followed me and came into the living room.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai followed me and came into the living room.

dialogues.jp:
昨日までは『ただいま』だったのに、不思議な
ものだ。
dialogues.en:
It's weird because she was saying "I'm home" until
yesterday.
dialogues.text:
It's weird because she was saying "I'm home" until
yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか不思議です。昨日もここに居たのに、
　懐かしい感じがします」
dialogues.en:
"I feel strange. I was just here yesterday, but I missed
this place already."
dialogues.text:
"I feel strange. I was just here yesterday, but I missed
this place already."

dialogues.jp:
優しげな瞳を｛ほの／仄｝かに潤ませ、部屋の風景を確か
めるように言う。
dialogues.en: She looked around the room with soft teary eyes.
dialogues.text: She looked around the room with soft teary eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「はは、ホント不思議ですね」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it's strange."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it's strange."

dialogues.jp: ソファーに座り、萌先輩にも隣を勧める。
dialogues.en: I sat on the couch and urged her to sit down too.
dialogues.text: I sat on the couch and urged her to sit down too.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、大丈夫です。それより、お掃除を始め
　ますね」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm fine. I need to start cleaning now."
dialogues.text: "No, I'm fine. I need to start cleaning now."

dialogues.jp:
おだやかに微笑むと、先輩はまず、床に転がっ
ている物を整理し始める。
dialogues.en:
She smiled calmly and started organizing what was lying on
the floor.
dialogues.text:
She smiled calmly and started organizing what was lying on
the floor.

dialogues.jp:
俺はその後姿を眺めながら、さっきまでの憂鬱
な気分が綺麗に消えていくのを感じていた。
dialogues.en:
As I watched her work, I felt my gloomy feeling quietly
going away.
dialogues.text:
As I watched her work, I felt my gloomy feeling quietly
going away.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだ萌先輩。今度の日曜日にまたデートし
　ませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, Moe-sempai, do you want to go out for a date
again on Sunday?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, Moe-sempai, do you want to go out for a date
again on Sunday?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。喜んで」
dialogues.en: "Sure, I'd love to."
dialogues.text: "Sure, I'd love to."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、商店街の喫茶店で待ち合わせしよう」
dialogues.en: "Then let's meet in the cafe at the shopping arcade."
dialogues.text: "Then let's meet in the cafe at the shopping arcade."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、外で待ち合わせしてデートするの
は初めてだな。
dialogues.en:
This is our first time meeting somewhere else to have a
date.
dialogues.text:
This is our first time meeting somewhere else to have a
date.

dialogues.jp:
たったそれだけのことなのに、なんかドキドキ
する。
dialogues.en: It's a simple thing, but my heart was racing.
dialogues.text: It's a simple thing, but my heart was racing.

dialogues.jp: （楽しみだな……）
dialogues.en: (I'm excited......)
dialogues.text: (I'm excited......)

dialogues.jp:
柄にもなくそんなことを思う。目の前では、さっ
きよりも軽やかな萌先輩の掃除が進行していた。
dialogues.en:
It's really unlike me to be excited about something like
this. Moe-sempai continued to clean up the room with a merry
pace.
dialogues.text:
It's really unlike me to be excited about something like
this. Moe-sempai continued to clean up the room with a merry
pace.

dialogues.jp: ◆お掃除◆
dialogues.en: ◆Cleaning up◆
dialogues.text: ◆Cleaning up◆

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が来てくれた。何だか良く分からないが、
掃除をしに来てくれたらしい。とにかく、嬉し
いぞ。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai came to visit me. I don't know why but she came
to clean up my house. Anyway, it made me feel happy.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai came to visit me. I don't know why but she came
to clean up my house. Anyway, it made me feel happy.
